items.title: White
items.description: The natural White that captivates with its pure radiance, combining classic with elegance.

items.title: Black
items.description: With its dark and mysterious allure, Black embraces a contemporary aesthetic, leaving a bold impression.

items.title: Jet Black Metallic
items.description: Jet Black Metallic combines a deep black color with subtle metallic flakes for a striking shine. This modern look retains a classic appeal.

items.title: Vanadium Grey Metallic
items.description: Vanadium Grey Metallic, named after the silvery-grey, lustrous chemical element, embodies an extremely technical color scheme. Its sporty and powerful effect was first visible on the 718 Spyder RS.

items.title: GT Silver Metallic
items.description: GT Silver Metallic is an extremely popular shade among Porsche customers. Its sporty and simultaneously elegant effect particularly accentuates the design of a Porsche.

items.title: Ice Grey Metallic
items.description: Ice Grey Metallic is a modern white with subtle grey undertones. It's a contemporary shade that embodies a sporty yet elegant style.

items.title: Guards Red
items.description: Definitely one of the most iconic colors in Porsche history, among the most popular choices for numerous 911 and 944 models and more. Even today, the demand for this vibrant red remains undiminished - an all-time favorite.

items.title: Gentian Blue Metallic
items.description: Gentian Blue Metallic exudes sophistication and style. The color variation ranges from a deep blue to a subtle violet undertone in bright light.

items.title: Carmine Red
items.description: Carmine Red is a striking and bold color that perfectly embodies the high-performance capabilities especially of Porsche's GTS models. It's a particularly deep and intense red.

items.title: Cartagena Yellow Metallic
items.description: The shade ""Cartagena Yellow Metallic"" reflects the vibrant energy of the city of Cartagena in northern Colombia, known for its brightly colored and often yellow house facades.

items.title: Provence
items.description: This unique shade embodies sporty aesthetics. The name Provence gives a hint to the color's fine and darker violet hue, that captures the beauty of the lavender fields in France's Provence Region.

items.title: Lugano Blue
items.description: Lugano Blue is inspired by historic colors such as Acid Blue and Arrow Blue, bridging the gap between heritage and modernity in the Porsche color palette.

items.title: Oak Green Metallic Neo
items.description: Oak Green Metallic Neo is a special reinterpretation ("Neo") of the historic color Oak Green Metallic. This reinterpretation preserves the essence of the classic color while giving it a fresh allure.

items.title: Aventurine Green Metallic
items.description: A hint of green provides Aventurine Green Metallic with an elegant appearance, while the metallic component ensures special depth and a fascinating shimmer.

items.title: Shade Green Metallic
items.description: Shade Green Metallic is a pastel green that was first introduced with the 992 911 Dakar. Both the sportiness and the modern aspect of the color result in a unique visual character, enhancing the vehicle's dynamic allure.

items.title: Slate Grey Neo
items.description: Slate Grey Neo: The modern evolution ("Neo") of an iconic classic. This reinterpretation preserves the essence of the highly beloved Slate Grey, connecting tradition with modernity.

items.title: Chalk
items.description: Chalk is a light gray color that is often associated with sportiness. The non-metallic character of this color is particularly popular with many customers worldwide.

items.title: Titanium Wheel Bolts
items.description: The titanium wheel bolts reflect lightweight construction and performance both visually and technically. They reduce unsprung mass thanks to a weight savings of 2.2 lbs per vehicle set compared to the standard steel bolts. The corrosion-resistant high-end material and the extremely hard coating of diamond-like carbon (DLC) ensure optimum protection against wear.

20/21-inch 911 Carrera lightweight wheel set (painted in brilliant silver)
items.description:
In close cooperation with the developers at the Porsche Development Center in Weissach, a technologically sophisticated forged wheel has been created that blends harmoniously into the dynamic design line of the 911 and meets the performance requirements of the Manthey developers to the same extent.
The result: a reduction of the unsprung and rotating masses by 9.6 kg per vehicle set, which noticeably benefits the response behavior of the spring-damper elements and further improves vehicle controllability.

The 20/21-inch 911 Carrera lightweight wheel set (without tires, valve and tire pressure monitoring system sensor) is available in the following paint finishes:
- Brilliant silver
- Black (satin)
- Neodyme

The wheel sets are suitable for the corresponding tire sizes:
Front axle: 8.5 J x 20 RO 50 with tires 245/35 ZR 20 (95Y) XL,
Rear axle: 11.5 J x 21 RO 79 with tires 305/30 ZR 21 (104Y) XL.  

Note: The wheel hub covers are included in the scope of delivery.

items.title: Surround View with Active Parking Support
items.description:
3D Surround View:
The 3D display allows the driver to influence the perspective displayed, resulting in a better all-round view. Images are displayed on the screen of the Porsche Communication Management (PCM).
Active Parking Support:
The system automatically detects parking spaces and measures their size. Once the system has signaled that the parking space is of sufficient size, the driver can initiate and control the parking process. The system automatically takes over the steering and the forward and reverse movement of the vehicle. The Active Parking Support is able to park the vehicle in parallel and perpendicular parking spaces.
Maneuvering Assist:
The Maneuvering Assist can, where system limitations allow, prevent collisions through braking in tight and complex maneuvering situations when reversing.
Note: Active Parking Assistance can help you park your vehicle. However, it may not function correctly if one or more of the parking sensors are damaged, dirty or covered, or exposed to weather conditions (snow, fog, heavy rain) that might interfere with sensor operation. Before using, always inspect the parking area with your own eyes to ensure that it is clear of items that might be harmed or might harm your vehicle.

items.title: Remote ParkAssist
items.description:
Laws in some areas may restrict the use of Remote ParkAssist.

Remote-Controlled Parking:Remote-controlled parking allows the driver to enter and leave a parking space via smartphone. The system automatically detects parallel and perpendicular parking spaces and measures their size. If the parking space is a sufficient size, the driver can exit the vehicle then initiate the park maneuvers. At the end of the parking maneuver, the vehicle is automatically switched off and locked.
Garage Pilot:The Garage Pilot uses the same principle as the remote-controlled parking and is used when the vehicle is to be parked in a narrow garage without the driver being in the vehicle. The driver can also use this function to make the vehicle leave the garage.
Lane Change Assist (LCA):Alerts the driver to vehicles rapidly approaching from behind or vehicles travelling at the same speed in potential blind spots. The warning is emitted by lights in the exterior mirrors. The function is activated by the driver using the Porsche Communication Management (PCM) and is available from approximately 19+ mph. Below this speed range, Turn Assist (rear) also comes to the driver's aid by monitoring the area to the rear of the vehicle in turning situations.
Active Parking Support:The system automatically detects parking spaces. Once the system has signaled that the parking space is a sufficient size, the driver can initiate and control the parking process while still in the vehicle. The system automatically takes over the steering as well as the forward and backward movement of the vehicle. The Active Parking Support is able to park the vehicle in parallel and perpendicular parking spaces.
3D Surround View:The 3D Surround View display allows the driver to influence the perspective displayed within the Porsche Communication Management (PCM) screen, resulting in a better all-round view. This allows for an enhanced view of your surroundings while parking.
Rear Cross Traffic Alert:The Rear Cross Traffic Alert uses the rear radar and, where system limitations allow, warns the driver when reversing slowly of oncoming traffic when the parking aid is activated. The system warns, for example, of critically approaching vehicles when leaving a perpendicular parking space. The information is provided in stages – visually on the PCM screen, audibly and, if necessary, with a jolt of the brakes.
Note: Your smartphone and operating system must be compatible with the My Porsche app. Further information on compatibility can be found in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. The assistance provided by Remote Park Assist is subject to system limitations. The driver must monitor at all times and intervene in cases of doubt.

items.title: Lane Change Assist (LCA)
items.description: Alerts the driver to vehicles rapidly approaching from behind or vehicles travelling at the same speed in potential blind spots. The warning is emitted by lights in the exterior mirrors. The function is activated by the driver using Porsche Communication Management (PCM) and is available from approximately 19+ mph. Below this speed range, Turn Assist (rear) also comes to the driver's aid by monitoring the area to the rear of the vehicle in turning situations.

items.title: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)
items.description: Radar-based technology that monitors and automatically regulates the distance from the vehicle in front as required even down to a halt by means of the stop-and-go function (usable at 19+ mph). Additional functions: audible warning if too close; warning by active jolt of the brakes; strategic braking; visual and audible warning if objects are detected within collision range.

items.title: Porsche InnoDrive incl. Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Active Lane Keep (ALK)
items.description:
Expansion of the Adaptive Cruise Control by additional functions:

Porsche InnoDrive: Regulates driving speed based on high-definition navigation data, radar, and video sensor technology in order to deliver typical Porsche driving feel, increased efficiency, and improved comfort. Driving speed is predictively adapted to speed restrictions and road topography (elevation changes, corners). At the same time, Porsche InnoDrive controls acceleration, deceleration, and gear selection (including coasting). The system looks ahead up to 1.8 miles, and analyzes the real-time driving strategy, providing a harmonious and efficient drive. Traffic Jam Assist works alongside the driver in highly congested sections of roadway (up to approximately 37 mph). It actively guides the vehicle along with gentle steering inputs and follows the traffic ahead where system limitations allow. In the process, Traffic Jam Assist takes into consideration roadway markings and other vehicles on the roadway.

Active Lane Keep: Another feature of Porsche InnoDrive including Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) is Active Lane Keep Assist. It combines ACC and Lane-Keeping functionality on major roads and highways. The system follows the line of traffic ahead and lane markings, within the limits of the system, and keeps the vehicle in the middle of the lane by continuous steering adjustments – even in congested conditions. Active Lane Keep Assist is beneficial to stress relief and greater comfort on long journeys.

items.title: Night Vision Assist
items.description: Infrared thermal image displayed in the instrument cluster. Provides the driver with information beyond the range of the headlights. Detected pedestrians, deer, and other large wildlife are highlighted in yellow. Pedestrians within critical range are highlighted in red, and the driver receives an audio/visual warning.

Thanks to the handy power click system, the roof box can be installed quickly and easily. For the transportation of dogs weighing up to 8 kg, the box can be easily secured using the ISOFIX/latch connection. The ISOFIX/latch system was developed for the safe and uncomplicated attachment of child seats. Please note that the 911 models can only be installed on the front passenger seat.

The black dog transport box with embossed "PORSCHE" logo is made of high-quality, non-toxic materials. The floor and interior walls are fitted with comfortable black and red upholstery. These are removable and washable. If required, the enclosed wedge-shaped cushion can be placed under the box to compensate for the inclination of the vehicle seats and thus provide the animals with a flat surface to lie on.

Note: The dog transport box is also compatible with the Porsche child seat base. This provides additional protection for the vehicle seats.

items.title: Porsche Dashcam
items.description:
The Porsche Dashcam (only for vehicles with pre-installation) is suitable for video recording of driving situations and during parking. It is operated via the associated app, in which all settings can be made. Recorded videos are stored on the SD card supplied and overwritten on a rolling basis. If the dashcam detects a vibration or the radar sensor is triggered, the recorded video is saved separately and not overwritten. Recordings can be downloaded directly from the SD card or via the app.

A front dashcam for mounting on the windshield is available for 911 Cabrio and Targa models. In addition to the front dashcam, a second dashcam is attached to the rear window on 911 Coupé models.

Details:
- Recording of videos in QHD
- Audio recording (can be deactivated)
- GPS sensor
- Radar sensor for video recording when an object approaches the vehicle
- Shock sensor
- Lens with polarization filter to reduce reflections and improve colors and contrasts
- Bracket for fixed installation on the vehicle

"Driving" operating mode:
The Porsche Dashcam is ready for use when the engine is started. If a vibration event occurs, the 10 seconds before the event and the time after the event are saved. The "Continuous" setting in the app can be used to deactivate the vibration sensor for driving recordings on the racetrack.

"Parking" operating mode:
While parked, the dashcam is ready for use via the sleep function. Recording takes place after triggering by the radar sensor or the vibration sensor. The duration and scope of the sleep function depends on the vehicle model and equipment. For more information, please contact your Porsche partner.

If the vehicle has a Sport Chrono Package and Porsche Connect, the Porsche Dashcam can also be connected to the Porsche Track Precision app. The recording can be made via the front and/or rear camera.

Notes: Only for vehicles with pre-installed Porsche Dashcam. Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG has no access to the data collected. The installation and permitted use of traffic cameras in your Porsche vehicle may be regulated and/or restricted by local data protection regulations.
The exact positioning of the front dashcam on the windshield depends on the country.
Depending on the vehicle configuration, further additional features may have to be ordered. Some accessories may require additional parts or installation costs. For further information, please contact your Porsche Center.

Inspired by the iconic design of the legendary winning vehicle, this wrapping emphasizes your Porsche's motorsport DNA and is guaranteed to get recognition.
Note: This is a partial wrapping. The "Salzburg" design wrap is available in White. The design wrapping can be combined with all exterior colors and personalized with starting numbers.
Would you like to give your Porsche an unmistakable, personal signature?Give free rein to your creativity and design according to your wishes. With the possibilities of our Sonderwunsch program, you can configure your Porsche to be as individual as you are.

Personal lettering or logos combined with customized designs and colors. We take attention to detail to a new level.
You dream it. We build it.

flatOptions.title: Surround View with Active Parking Support
flatOptions.description:
3D Surround View:
The 3D display allows the driver to influence the perspective displayed, resulting in a better all-round view. Images are displayed on the screen of the Porsche Communication Management (PCM).
Active Parking Support:
The system automatically detects parking spaces and measures their size. Once the system has signaled that the parking space is of sufficient size, the driver can initiate and control the parking process. The system automatically takes over the steering and the forward and reverse movement of the vehicle. The Active Parking Support is able to park the vehicle in parallel and perpendicular parking spaces.
Maneuvering Assist:
The Maneuvering Assist can, where system limitations allow, prevent collisions through braking in tight and complex maneuvering situations when reversing.
Note: Active Parking Assistance can help you park your vehicle. However, it may not function correctly if one or more of the parking sensors are damaged, dirty or covered, or exposed to weather conditions (snow, fog, heavy rain) that might interfere with sensor operation. Before using, always inspect the parking area with your own eyes to ensure that it is clear of items that might be harmed or might harm your vehicle.

flatOptions.title: Remote ParkAssist
flatOptions.description:
Laws in some areas may restrict the use of Remote ParkAssist.

Remote-Controlled Parking:Remote-controlled parking allows the driver to enter and leave a parking space via smartphone. The system automatically detects parallel and perpendicular parking spaces and measures their size. If the parking space is a sufficient size, the driver can exit the vehicle then initiate the park maneuvers. At the end of the parking maneuver, the vehicle is automatically switched off and locked.
Garage Pilot:The Garage Pilot uses the same principle as the remote-controlled parking and is used when the vehicle is to be parked in a narrow garage without the driver being in the vehicle. The driver can also use this function to make the vehicle leave the garage.
Lane Change Assist (LCA):Alerts the driver to vehicles rapidly approaching from behind or vehicles travelling at the same speed in potential blind spots. The warning is emitted by lights in the exterior mirrors. The function is activated by the driver using the Porsche Communication Management (PCM) and is available from approximately 19+ mph. Below this speed range, Turn Assist (rear) also comes to the driver's aid by monitoring the area to the rear of the vehicle in turning situations.
Active Parking Support:The system automatically detects parking spaces. Once the system has signaled that the parking space is a sufficient size, the driver can initiate and control the parking process while still in the vehicle. The system automatically takes over the steering as well as the forward and backward movement of the vehicle. The Active Parking Support is able to park the vehicle in parallel and perpendicular parking spaces.
3D Surround View:The 3D Surround View display allows the driver to influence the perspective displayed within the Porsche Communication Management (PCM) screen, resulting in a better all-round view. This allows for an enhanced view of your surroundings while parking.
Rear Cross Traffic Alert:The Rear Cross Traffic Alert uses the rear radar and, where system limitations allow, warns the driver when reversing slowly of oncoming traffic when the parking aid is activated. The system warns, for example, of critically approaching vehicles when leaving a perpendicular parking space. The information is provided in stages – visually on the PCM screen, audibly and, if necessary, with a jolt of the brakes.
Note: Your smartphone and operating system must be compatible with the My Porsche app. Further information on compatibility can be found in the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. The assistance provided by Remote Park Assist is subject to system limitations. The driver must monitor at all times and intervene in cases of doubt.

flatOptions.title: Lane Change Assist (LCA)
flatOptions.description: Alerts the driver to vehicles rapidly approaching from behind or vehicles travelling at the same speed in potential blind spots. The warning is emitted by lights in the exterior mirrors. The function is activated by the driver using Porsche Communication Management (PCM) and is available from approximately 19+ mph. Below this speed range, Turn Assist (rear) also comes to the driver's aid by monitoring the area to the rear of the vehicle in turning situations.

flatOptions.title: Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC)
flatOptions.description: Radar-based technology that monitors and automatically regulates the distance from the vehicle in front as required even down to a halt by means of the stop-and-go function (usable at 19+ mph). Additional functions: audible warning if too close; warning by active jolt of the brakes; strategic braking; visual and audible warning if objects are detected within collision range.

flatOptions.title: Porsche InnoDrive incl. Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) and Active Lane Keep (ALK)
flatOptions.description:
Expansion of the Adaptive Cruise Control by additional functions:

Porsche InnoDrive: Regulates driving speed based on high-definition navigation data, radar, and video sensor technology in order to deliver typical Porsche driving feel, increased efficiency, and improved comfort. Driving speed is predictively adapted to speed restrictions and road topography (elevation changes, corners). At the same time, Porsche InnoDrive controls acceleration, deceleration, and gear selection (including coasting). The system looks ahead up to 1.8 miles, and analyzes the real-time driving strategy, providing a harmonious and efficient drive. Traffic Jam Assist works alongside the driver in highly congested sections of roadway (up to approximately 37 mph). It actively guides the vehicle along with gentle steering inputs and follows the traffic ahead where system limitations allow. In the process, Traffic Jam Assist takes into consideration roadway markings and other vehicles on the roadway.

Active Lane Keep: Another feature of Porsche InnoDrive including Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC) is Active Lane Keep Assist. It combines ACC and Lane-Keeping functionality on major roads and highways. The system follows the line of traffic ahead and lane markings, within the limits of the system, and keeps the vehicle in the middle of the lane by continuous steering adjustments – even in congested conditions. Active Lane Keep Assist is beneficial to stress relief and greater comfort on long journeys.

flatOptions.description: Infrared thermal image displayed in the instrument cluster. Provides the driver with information beyond the range of the headlights. Detected pedestrians, deer, and other large wildlife are highlighted in yellow. Pedestrians within critical range are highlighted in red, and the driver receives an audio/visual warning.

The BOSE® Surround Sound System was specially developed for Porsche and along with the BOSE® Centerpoint technology, the system guarantees a spatial and powerful sound with its 12 speakers and 570 watts of total output.
Highlights:BOSE® Centerpoint Technology: Transforms music recorded in stereo format into a surround sound experience.
AudioPilot Noise Compensation Technology: Automatically adjusts the sound to the driving noise, ensuring a consistent and balanced sound experience.
With Dolby Atmos, you experience music, podcasts, or audiobooks in the car in a completely new way. For suitable audio formats, Dolby Atmos technology precisely distributes sounds in the space, creating an immersive soundscape where every detail becomes audible.

In detail:12 speakers including a center speaker and a subwoofer integrated into the vehicle body
570 watts of total output for powerful sound

Note: Playback of Dolby Atmos-enabled media must be done through apps that can be downloaded from the car's App Center. To use the Porsche App Center, you need an active Porsche Connect package and a data connection. The availability and content of these apps are provided by third parties and may vary by market or be changed without notice. An additional, paid subscription for apps supporting Dolby Atmos may be required.

flatOptions.title: Burmester® High-End Surround Sound System
flatOptions.description:

The active subwoofer with 300-watt Class D power amplifier integrated into the vehicle body delivers a powerful bass performance down to the deepest pitches.
With Dolby Atmos, you experience music, podcasts, or audiobooks in the car in a completely new way. For suitable audio formats, Dolby Atmos technology precisely distributes sounds in the space, creating an immersive soundscape where every detail becomes audible.

915 watts total output including a 300-watt active subwoofer integrated into the vehicle body
Combination of Class-D digital amplifier and Air Motion Transformer: Enables an intense music immersion.
2-way center system: Brings the stage tangibly into your vehicle.

flatOptions.title: Porsche Performance roof box
flatOptions.description:
The innovative Porsche Performance roof box was developed in the Porsche Development Centre in Weissach particularly for Porsche vehicles. During this process, it was subjected to elaborate testing in the high-tech wind tunnel. This resulted in an aerodynamic design with first-class drag coefficients.

In this way the Performance roof box combines sportiness with individual design and functionality: In the Black high-gloss design with silver "PORSCHE" logo on the rear, the aerodynamic plastic box perfectly fits with the exclusive style of your Porsche. Special highlight: The side blades painted in Black (high-gloss) are replaceable and are available both in selected exterior colors and in an individually paintable variant. The Porsche Perfomance roof box can be easily matched to your vehicle. With a volume of 480 liters and a possible payload of up to 75 kg, it offers plenty of additional storage space for your next adventure. Thanks to the handy power click system, the roof box can be installed quickly and easily. The roof box opens from both sides and comes fitted with fastening straps making loading extremely convenient.

Details:
- Roof box in Black (high-gloss),
- "PORSCHE" logo on rear in Silver,
- Replaceable side blades in Black (high-gloss),
- Dimensions: 83 x 35.75 x 17 inches (211.4 × 90.8 × 43.4 cm),
- Max. payload: 165 lbs (75 kg),
- Volume: 17 cubic feet (480 liters),
- Can be opened on both sides,
- Incl. 3 fastening straps,
- Incl. enclosed protective cover with "PORSCHE" logo

Replaceable side blades available in:
- Painted in Carrara White Metallic,
- Painted in Volcano Grey Metallic,
- Painted in Dolomite Silver Metallic,
- Can be painted in exterior color

Please note: Only in conjunction with basic roof transport system. Due to the aerodynamic sensitivity of the 911 models, a maximum speed of 130 km/h is recommended in conjunction with a loaded roof transport system. Some accessories may require additional parts or installation costs.

flatOptions.title: Dog carrier
flatOptions.description:
With the Porsche dog transport box, four-legged friends can be transported easily and safely in the vehicle interior.

For the transportation of dogs weighing up to 8 kg, the box can be easily secured using the ISOFIX/latch connection. The ISOFIX/latch system was developed for the safe and uncomplicated attachment of child seats. Please note that the 911 models can only be installed on the front passenger seat.

The black dog transport box with embossed "PORSCHE" logo is made of high-quality, non-toxic materials. The floor and interior walls are fitted with comfortable black and red upholstery. These are removable and washable. If required, the enclosed wedge-shaped cushion can be placed under the box to compensate for the inclination of the vehicle seats and thus provide the animals with a flat surface to lie on.

Note: The dog transport box is also compatible with the Porsche child seat base. This provides additional protection for the vehicle seats.

Details:
- Dog transport box in black
- Removable and washable inner padding in black and red
- Hinged front padding for impact and privacy protection
- Handles on the front and back
- Incl. ISOFIX/latch connection
- Incl. wedge-shaped cushion for inclined vehicle seats
- Dimensions: approx. 47.2 x 57 x 46.5 cm (width x depth x height)
- Weight: 7.5 kg

flatOptions.title: Porsche Dashcam
flatOptions.description:
The Porsche Dashcam (only for vehicles with pre-installation) is suitable for video recording of driving situations and during parking. It is operated via the associated app, in which all settings can be made. Recorded videos are stored on the SD card supplied and overwritten on a rolling basis. If the dashcam detects a vibration or the radar sensor is triggered, the recorded video is saved separately and not overwritten. Recordings can be downloaded directly from the SD card or via the app.

A front dashcam for mounting on the windshield is available for 911 Cabrio and Targa models. In addition to the front dashcam, a second dashcam is attached to the rear window on 911 Coupé models.

Details:
- Recording of videos in QHD
- Audio recording (can be deactivated)
- GPS sensor
- Radar sensor for video recording when an object approaches the vehicle
- Shock sensor
- Lens with polarization filter to reduce reflections and improve colors and contrasts
- Bracket for fixed installation on the vehicle

"Driving" operating mode:
The Porsche Dashcam is ready for use when the engine is started. If a vibration event occurs, the 10 seconds before the event and the time after the event are saved. The "Continuous" setting in the app can be used to deactivate the vibration sensor for driving recordings on the racetrack.

"Parking" operating mode:
While parked, the dashcam is ready for use via the sleep function. Recording takes place after triggering by the radar sensor or the vibration sensor. The duration and scope of the sleep function depends on the vehicle model and equipment. For more information, please contact your Porsche partner.

If the vehicle has a Sport Chrono Package and Porsche Connect, the Porsche Dashcam can also be connected to the Porsche Track Precision app. The recording can be made via the front and/or rear camera.

Notes: Only for vehicles with pre-installed Porsche Dashcam. Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG has no access to the data collected. The installation and permitted use of traffic cameras in your Porsche vehicle may be regulated and/or restricted by local data protection regulations.
The exact positioning of the front dashcam on the windshield depends on the country.
Depending on the vehicle configuration, further additional features may have to be ordered. Some accessories may require additional parts or installation costs. For further information, please contact your Porsche Center.

Looking for a sporty Porsche experience? Then the factory collection in Leipzig will set your pulse racing. During an intensive driving induction on the FIA-certified Porsche Circuit, we explain the functions of your new car in a comparable vehicle. At the controls and accompanied by a professional Porsche instructor, who provides important tips and tricks. Want some more driving? On our factory's own off-road track you and the Cayenne or Macan can tackle sensational off-road modules, such as a 100-metre long water crossing or an extreme ramp with an 80% gradient. During the factory tour, we also show you how a Porsche is produced. Relax and look back on your experience over a three-course meal in the exclusive restaurant in our Customer Centre. Then everything is set for your first drive in your new Porsche.
 
Appointments for factory collection are arranged through your Porsche Centre. They will be happy to provide information about the formalities and any local requirements. Please note that Leipzig factory collection appointments are subject to availability.
